source_note: The 23 live cue definitions, de-branded, synthesized from internal realtime cue research (§3). confidence_min null => use framework.gating_config.confidence_min[priority]. Triggers reference the signal layer (rep_talk_ratio, is_presenting, objection_intent, ...).

cues.name: Talk-ratio drift
cues.trigger_signal: rep_talk_ratio(3min) > 0.65 sustained >=30s during discovery

cues.name: Talk-ratio critical
cues.trigger_signal: rep_talk_ratio(5min) > 0.75 during discovery

cues.name: Monologue too long
cues.trigger_signal: current_monologue_sec(R) > 75 with no question inside it

cues.name: Prospect not opening up
cues.trigger_signal: at 10:00 mark: longest_prospect_story < 20s OR prospect_talk_ratio < 0.30

cues.name: Question drought
cues.trigger_signal: time_since_last_rep_question > 90s during discovery

cues.name: Weak/leading question
cues.trigger_signal: classifier flags closed/leading question streak >= 3

cues.name: No connection yet
cues.trigger_signal: rep asked a situation/business question first AND connection_count = 0 in first 2:00

cues.name: No problem-awareness
cues.trigger_signal: problem_awareness_count = 0 at minute 6
cues.cue_text: Find the problem — what's not working?

cues.name: Missed pain signal
cues.trigger_signal: pain_signal(P) fired AND rep's next turn changed topic or started presenting
cues.cue_text: They named a problem — dig in

cues.name: Pitching too early
cues.trigger_signal: is_presenting(R) becomes true while problem_awareness_count = 0 OR consequence_count = 0
cues.cue_text: Too early — build the gap first

cues.name: No consequence before pitch
cues.trigger_signal: rep enters transition/present with consequence_count = 0

cues.name: Consequence prompt
cues.trigger_signal: consequence_count = 0 at minute 8 AND problem_awareness exists

cues.name: Mirror the pain
cues.trigger_signal: pain_signal(P) fired AND mirror_used = false in rep's reply

cues.name: Needy tone / upward inflection
cues.trigger_signal: f0_terminal_slope > 0 (rising) + high energy_rms on rep questions, >=2 in 60s

cues.name: Pace too fast
cues.trigger_signal: pace_wpm(R) > 165 sustained >=20s

cues.name: Filler-word spike
cues.trigger_signal: filler_rate(R) > 6 per minute

cues.name: Interrupting prospect
cues.trigger_signal: interruption_event count >= 2 in 3 min (esp. during a pain story)

cues.name: Impatient / no silence
cues.trigger_signal: rep starts speaking < 0.7s after prospect stops, repeatedly

cues.name: Objection — clarify first
cues.trigger_signal: objection_intent(P) detected
cues.cue_text: Clarify: 'what do you mean by that?'

cues.name: Defensive on objection
cues.trigger_signal: after objection, rep turn > 15s of feature/logic rebuttal with no clarifying question

cues.name: No qualifying before close
cues.trigger_signal: transition/commit question issued with qualifying_count = 0
cues.cue_text: Qualify: how important is fixing this?

cues.name: Buying signal — advance
cues.trigger_signal: buying_signal(P) detected AND rep keeps presenting
cues.cue_text: They're ready — ask for the next step

cues.name: Missing next-step (end)
cues.trigger_signal: in the last 5 min of scheduled length, commitment_count = 0
